coordinates.locator: site:fermilab-main-campus coordinates field, sourced to the LBNF/DUNE official project website (src:fermilab-lbnf-dune-site), reused here per the wave-3 brief's campus-point fallback for a detector hall with no separately published coordinate
coordinates.note: No fetched source gives a specific coordinate for the CDF (B0) interaction hall itself; this point is the Fermilab campus centroid (reused, with its existing source, from site:fermilab-main-campus per A23) and is only campus-precision, not a survey of this hall. The Tevatron ring is about 6.3 km in circumference (about 1 km radius), so the true position could be up to roughly 2 km from this point in an unknown direction.

name: CDF collision hall (Tevatron B0)
notes: Coordinates reuse the sourced Fermilab main-campus point from site:fermilab-main-campus (src:fermilab-lbnf-dune-site), per the wave-3 brief's explicit fallback for a detector hall whose own coordinates are not separately published: a sourced campus point marked approximate. No source found this session gives a dedicated lat/lon for this specific interaction hall; the Tevatron ring (about 6.3 km circumference, about 1 km radius) means the true position could be up to roughly 2 km from this point.

The INSPIRE experiment record long_name for CDF is "Study of Proton Anti-proton Collisions Using a Large Detector at B0 -- the CDF Detector" (src:colliders-historical-cdf-inspire-experiment-record), confirming the B0 location name, though not coordinates.

summary.plain: The interaction hall on the Fermilab Tevatron ring where the CDF detector sat, in Batavia, Illinois. Its own precise position is not published in a source found this session, so it is shown at the precision of the wider Fermilab site.
summary.technical: CDF collision hall (Tevatron B0): one of the Tevatron ring's interaction regions, at Fermilab, Batavia, Illinois. No dedicated survey coordinate for the hall itself was found; shown at Fermilab campus precision (~3 km) as an approximate marker.
